configuration_parameters.description: Molecular geometry passed to gto.M or Mole.build.
configuration_parameters.name: atom

configuration_parameters.description: Active electrons or alpha/beta active electrons.
configuration_parameters.name: nelecas

configuration_parameters.description: 1-based active orbital indices passed to sort_mo/sort_mo_by_irrep.
configuration_parameters.name: active_orbital_sort

configuration_parameters.description: CASSCF orbital/CI gradient threshold; defaults to sqrt(conv_tol).
configuration_parameters.name: conv_tol_grad

configuration_parameters.description: Residual threshold for accepting early AH steps.
configuration_parameters.name: ah_start_tol

configuration_parameters.description: Minimum AH cycles before early AH step acceptance.
configuration_parameters.name: ah_start_cycle

entry_points.description: Factory for RHF/ROHF-based CASSCF; selects symmetry-adapted or non-symmetry CASSCF and DF variants as needed.
entry_points.name: mcscf.CASSCF

entry_points.call_signature: mc.kernel(mo_coeff=None, ci0=None, callback=None); mc.mc1step(mo_coeff=None, ci0=None, callback=None)
entry_points.description: Primary one-step CASSCF macro/micro optimizer using orbital AH/CIAH updates, approximate CI response, CASCI refreshes, checkpointing, and callbacks.
entry_points.name: CASSCF.kernel / mc1step

entry_points.description: Two-step CASSCF driver; alternates orbital optimization and CASCI solves with one micro pass per macro step.
entry_points.name: CASSCF.mc2step

entry_points.description: Second-order CASSCF driver optimizing orbital rotations and CI coefficients together through matrix-free augmented-Hessian Davidson iterations.
entry_points.name: CASSCF.newton().kernel

entry_points.description: Builds active-space Hamiltonian from orbitals, runs the configured FCI solver, and returns total/CAS energy and CI coefficients.
entry_points.name: CASCI.kernel

entry_points.call_signature: davidson_cc(h_op, g_op, precond, x0, tol=1e-10, max_cycle=30, lindep=1e-14, dot=numpy.dot, verbose=logger.WARN)
entry_points.description: Internal augmented-Hessian Davidson generator used by CASSCF orbital/CIAH updates.
entry_points.name: ciah.davidson_cc

immutable_paths: pyscf/lib/** C sources and CMake files unless explicitly in editable_paths

output_quantities.description: Boolean convergence flag on the MCSCF/CASCI object.
Final total CASSCF/CASCI energy including nuclear repulsion.
Per-state energies for state-averaged or multi-root runs.
Final orbital-gradient norm exposed through callbacks or recomputed via get_grad.
Final CI-gradient norm when the runner can expose it.
Overlap-based root identity diagnostics for state-specific or state-averaged cases.
Wall time measured only around the selected CASSCF call.
Total Hessian-vector/AH operator calls, visible in Newton logs/callback state as Hx or JK counts.

runtime_command_template: from pyscf import gto, scf, mcscf; mol=gto.M(atom=ATOM,basis=BASIS,charge=CHARGE,spin=SPIN,symmetry=SYMMETRY,verbose=0); mf=scf.RHF(mol).run(conv_tol=MF_CONV_TOL); mc=mcscf.CASSCF(mf,NCAS,NELECAS); mo=mc.sort_mo(CASLIST) if CASLIST else mf.mo_coeff; solver=mc.newton() if SOLVER=='newton' else mc; out=solver.mc2step(mo) if SOLVER=='mc2step' else solver.kernel(mo); print({'e_tot': out[0], 'converged': solver.converged})

suggested_cases.description: Goal workload: benzene pi CAS(6,6), symmetry enabled, Newton-CASSCF matrix-free AH/CIAH path.
Goal test workload: same benzene active space with larger AO/virtual space.
Symmetry-enabled N2 CAS(6,6) Newton-CASSCF regression from mcscf tests.
State-averaged H2O CAS(4,4) Newton case stressing multi-root/root-identity handling.
Existing benzene test with larger active space, useful for mc1step macro/micro behavior.

threading_model.description: Python orchestration over NumPy/SciPy BLAS plus PySCF C extensions. CMake builds C extensions with OpenMP when available; PySCF exposes lib.num_threads()/with_omp_threads for OpenMP control. For this campaign, use OpenMP parallelism in PySCF and keep BLAS/NumExpr single-threaded for deterministic timing.
